$comment: Everything the fork changes relative to upstream. tools/fork/check-fork.mjs enforces this in CI and FORK.md explains it. Register a new hook here in the same commit that adds it.

touchpoints.purpose: A short banner at the top of upstream's README saying what this fork adds and pointing at FORK.md.
Passes upstream's config through withForkIdentity from fork.config.ts, so the fork has its own name and bundle ID and installs beside the official app.
Puts the menu button at the top left of the Books screen. It opens the side menu with Books and Podcasts.
Shows the atmosphere sounds' section (on and off, volume, how much is going on, the car, importing a sounds folder) under the reading settings.
Adds the atmosphere sounds button to the player's toolbar for readaloud books, in both the read-along and listening screens.
Imports lofi/readerFollow.ts for its listeners, so the sounds follow the pages while the listener reads a readaloud book on screen with the narration stopped.

Lets the atmosphere pause the narration for a moment at a big scene change (the hold in LofiNarratorBridge.swift) without the app, the lock screen or the remote buttons seeing a pause, and ends that hold on pause, play or the sleep timer. Each of the eight lock-screen handlers also asks LofiRemoteHandoff.swift first, so a playing podcast owns the lock screen and headphone buttons.
